description: This file contains shell script code that sets up and tests Git repository configurations, hooks, and ref processing involving multiple repositories and custom scripts like 'test_expect_success', 'test_hook', and 'format_and_save_expect'. It appears to be part of a testing framework for Git ref processing and hook execution.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, used for setting up and verifying Git operations and hooks.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Invokes a hook script within a Git repository context, used for testing hook behavior.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats output and saves it for comparison, aiding in verifying test results.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output files/strings in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git refs between repositories to verify ref states.
